name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Either Frost goes with Scouts or Frost goes with Robotics.
Between Chess and Robotics, one goes with 79% and the other with 81%.
75% goes with Scouts if and only if all of Debate does not go with Ellis, Hale goes with Scouts, and 77% goes with Boyd.
Ellis, Frost, and Debate go with 77%, 79%, and 81%, in some order.
Either Frost goes with 77%, or Chess goes with 79% — but not both.

hints.text: Suppose Frost went with Chess — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Frost goes with Chess.

…but now the clue “Either Frost goes with Scouts or Frost goes with Robotics” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Frost does not go with Chess.
